svg.title: Shakunetsu Sakura — Dragon of Falling Petals. Draft 1 / Scorch classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Ember Dragon's Roots forks into Kindled Boughs then Dragon in Full Blossom, or Branded by Petals then Scorching Hanami. Falling Ember Petals forks into Burning Petal Carpet then Conflagration in Bloom, or Smothering Petal Rain then Deluge of Burning Petals. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Scorch-classified Shakunetsu Sakura jutsu.

The two A-rank Hiru-Sakura circles carry the only Damage rows (Sakuragari 40, Sakura-ame 50 Scorch power at jutsu level 25, one hit on every user inside the radius-1 area) and are the declared primary; the kit's Damage Over Time trait lives on Dancing Embers' unsupported wound. Increase Damage Taken is the broadest tag by reach (two 35% rows on the Sakuragari circle and the Sakura Dragon Tree, all four stat types and no element, so every non-pierce hit on the exposed target is amplified), and the D-rank 40 AP Sakura Dragon Tree also carries the kit's single 35% self Increase Damage Given (Fire, None, Scorch, Wind) on top of the bloodline's same-element passive, so those two share the secondary. Petals"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Node split: two roots mirror the kit's two faces. Ember Dragon's Roots (Pearl, Dragon Tree) forks into Kindled Boughs \u2192 Dragon in Full Blossom (Increase Damage Given) and Branded by Petals \u2192 Scorching Hanami (Increase Damage Taken). Falling Ember Petals (the two Hiru-Sakura circles) forks into Burning Petal Carpet \u2192 Conflagration in Bloom (Damage) and Smothering Petal Rain \u2192 Deluge of Burning Petals (Decrease Damage Given). 2F/4H/4A; every Advanced Art is 3 BP deep; any two cost 5 or 6 BP.","Flats scale by coverage. Damage reaches two rows: 1+2+3 = +6 (the guardrail). Increase Damage Given is one self row: 2/3/5 = +10 (35\u219245%). Increase Damage Taken reaches two rows that stack on one target, so it stops at +6 (2+4, 35\u219241%), under the +7 ceiling. Decrease Damage Given is one enemy row: 2/3/5 = +10 (30\u219240%). Heal is one raw-power row: 2+3 = +5 (300 HP a tick). Capstone secondaries under-bid the Hidden Art on their tag (IDG +2 < Kindled Boughs +3; Damage +1 < Burning Petal Carpet +2).","Interactions: the Dragon Tree buff row (Fire, None, Scorch, Wind) multiplies the Scorch circles, element-less hits (basic attacks, weapons) and Fire/Wind jutsu in its 2-round window; the bloodline's same-element IDG passive (25 + 0.15/level) stacks on top. Both IDT rows list all four stat types and no element, so every hit on the exposed target, from the player, allies or weapons, is amplified. Pierce runs after the modifier pass and is neither raised nor amplified.","Delivery: every cast has cooldown 7. Sakuragari and Sakura-ame are 60 AP OTHER_USER AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN casts at range 4; per the batch-1 Aerathiel read, their INHERIT rows land once on every other living user in the radius-1 circle, with no ground effect: one Scorch hit and 2-round debuffs per user. The Dragon Tree is a 40 AP single-target cast at range 5 (legal target needed; self buff and enemy exposure together). The Pearl is a 40 AP self cast; its Heal ticks on following rounds.","Fourth purchases: Burst \u2192 Ember Dragon's Roots (buff 37%, Pearl 270) or Smothering Petal Rain (suppression 35%); Exposure \u2192 Falling Ember Petals (circles 41/51, suppression 32%) or Kindled Boughs (buff 42%); Amplifier \u2192 Branded by Petals (exposure 37%) or Falling Ember Petals; Suppression \u2192 Burning Petal Carpet (circles 44/54) or Ember Dragon's Roots (circles 42/52). No-capstone hybrids: 01,02,04,06 (buff 40%, exposure 37%) and 01,06,07,09 (circles 43/53, suppression 35%).","Row weight (\u03a3 flat \u00d7 rows reached): the strongest full builds are 01,04,05,06 (22) and 01,02,04,05 (21) on 7 rows, 3.1 per row against Taiyo Kami's 31 on 9 rows (3.4). Burst builds score 17\u201318 because Damage reaches two rows, but each Damage point lands on every user in a circle and the Scorch passive multiplies it, so the metric undervalues area damage. All 14 legal full allocations are non-dominated and every node appears in at least one (audit). Not simulated."],"risks":["Classification: Scorch is not exclusive in the census (Taiyo Kami carries 4 Scorch rows, 3 damage). Under the current resolver a Scorch modifier reaches the 3 Scorch rows directly and the 4 element-less rows only via None, which also reaches other non-elemental jutsu; the tree assumes the proposed bloodline-scoped whole-kit classification. NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT jutsu carrying Scorch is unverified.","Ally hazard: Sakuragari rows 0 (Damage) and 1 (exposure) and Sakura-ame row 0 (Damage) are AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN rows with no friendlyFire value (=ALL), so allies inside the radius-1 circle take the enhanced Scorch hit and exposure too; the caster is never a target (batch-1 read). Nodes 06/07/08/10 (Damage) and 04/05 (IDT) raise that; positioning decides. Sakura-ame's suppression row is ENEMIES only.","Exposure stacking: the Sakuragari circle and the Dragon Tree each apply a separate 2-round Increase Damage Taken debuff and BATTLE_TAG_STACKING is on at the pin, so a target caught by both carries 70% base and 82% at the route maximum, amplifying every non-pierce hit from the player, allies and weapons. The route is held to +6 and both IDT nodes sit on one branch for this reason; not simulated.","Increase Damage Given leakage: the Sakura Dragon Tree self buff (Fire, None, Scorch, Wind) multiplies normal jutsu, weapons and basic attacks in its window, not only kit casts, and stacks with the bloodline's same-element passive (about 29% at level 25) as separate effects; 45% is far below the 100 cap. Restricted casting scope does not restrict downstream benefit.","Area delivery: the dossier footnote calls AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN rows re-applied ground effects reaching the caster; the batch-1 Aerathiel read found OTHER_USER circles apply INHERIT rows once, directly to users in the radius-1 area, with no ground effect and the caster excluded. This tree follows that read, unverified here; if the circles persist, the Damage route is worth more than stated.","Unsupported rows: Dancing Embers (pierce 60, wound 30%), the Pearl's debuffprevent, Sakuragari's self shield and the visual rows receive no bonus. Because pierce bypasses the damage-modifier pass, the Amplifier and Exposure routes do not raise the pierce hit and the Suppression route does not reduce enemy pierce; the kit's B-rank attack is outside every node.","Heal: the Pearl's Heal row has rounds 2 and applies on following rounds (static, \u00d710 HP per power), so +5 is 300 HP per tick against 250; tick count per cast and healprevent were not simulated. Heal appears only on the dragon root (Foundation +2, Dragon in Full Blossom +3), so the Amplifier capstone carries the whole sustain gain; the row is small enough that this is accepted rather than split.","Rank and modes: an A-rank bloodline whose Damage rows are formula-calculated (sqrt stat scaling) and then multiplied by the Scorch IDG passive, so +6 raw power is not a linear +6. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are suppressed in ranked PvP and ranked sparring; normal-tree potency policy is not approved, so a combined stacking audit precedes any implementation. No combat simulation was performed."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":14,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":10,"decreasedamagegiven":10,"increasedamagetaken":6,"heal":5},"supported_rows_in_kit":7,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":2,"decreasedamagegiven":1,"heal":1,"increasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagetaken":2},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagegiven","heal","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 1 / Scorch classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Shakunetsu Sakura jutsu inherit Scorch potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."]},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","04"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":10,"increasedamagetaken":2,"heal":5}},{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":10,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"heal":5}},{"ids":["01","02","04","05"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":7,"increasedamagetaken":6,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":5,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":5,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":5,"decreasedamagegiven":5,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":6,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","04","06","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":2,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","06","07","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagegiven":5,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","06","09","10"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagegiven":10,"heal":2}},{"ids":["06","07","08","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"decreasedamagegiven":5}},{"ids":["06","07","09","10"],"bonuses":{"damage":4,"decreasedamagegiven":10}}]}

g.text: Draft 1 / Scorch classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Shakunetsu Sakura jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Conflagration in Bloom path + Ember Dragon's Roots
Scorching Hanami path + Falling Ember Petals
Dragon in Full Blossom path + Branded by Petals
Deluge of Burning Petals path + Burning Petal Carpet
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Heal additions are raw power: each +1 Heal power is +10 HP per tick of a static heal.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
